plan: Arrive in Krabi and take the boat to Railay. Easy first evening on Railay West beach.
romantic: Sunset on Railay West, then dinner by the sea.

plan: Four Islands longtail tour: Phra Nang Cave Beach, the Tup Island sandbar and snorkeling at Chicken Island.
romantic: Walk the sandbar together at low tide.

plan: Beginner rock climbing on Railay’s limestone cliffs, then the short hike to the Princess Lagoon viewpoint.
romantic: Couples Thai massage after the climb.

plan: Speedboat day to the Phi Phi Islands: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon and snorkeling stops.
romantic: Quiet evening at your pool villa.

plan: Sea-kayak into the Hong Islands lagoon, or swim at the jungle Emerald Pool and hot springs.
romantic: Private longtail boat at sunset, just the two of you.

plan: Morning flight to Bangkok. River boat to Wat Arun and Wat Pho, then the Jodd Fairs night market.
romantic: Cocktails at a rooftop sky bar.

plan: Grand Palace in the morning, then shopping at ICONSIAM by the river.
romantic: New Year’s Eve dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya with the riverside fireworks.

plan: Shopping at Siam Paragon and CentralWorld, then Chinatown (Yaowarat) street food.
romantic: Farewell dinner at a riverside restaurant.

plan: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and take a private car to Mui Ne on the expressway (about three to four hours).
romantic: Grilled seafood dinner on the beach road.

plan: Sunrise jeep or quad-bike ride on the White Sand Dunes, then the Fairy Stream walk and the fishing village.
romantic: Sunset together on the Red Sand Dunes.

plan: Kitesurfing lesson in the morning wind, then Ta Cu Mountain by cable car in the afternoon.
romantic: Couples spa at the resort.

plan: Drive back to Ho Chi Minh City. Evening walk around District 1 and the Ben Thanh street-food market.
romantic: Rooftop cocktails above the city.

plan: Half-day trip to the Cu Chi Tunnels, then the Central Post Office and the War Remnants Museum.
romantic: Dinner cruise on the Saigon River.

plan: Mekong Delta day trip: sampan boats through the coconut canals, local workshops and fruit orchards.
romantic: Quiet evening at a café in Thao Dien.

plan: Motorbike street-food tour with a local guide, then the New Year’s Eve celebrations.
romantic: Countdown on Nguyen Hue Walking Street, with fireworks over the river.

plan: Shopping at Saigon Centre, Takashimaya and Vincom, then the boutiques of Thao Dien.
romantic: Farewell dinner in a garden restaurant.

plan: Arrive via Kuala Lumpur and take the short flight to Langkawi. Relax on Pantai Cenang.
romantic: Sunset beachfront dinner.

plan: SkyCab cable car and the Sky Bridge, then swim at the Seven Wells waterfall.
romantic: Sunset at the quiet Tanjung Rhu beach.

plan: Jet-ski island tour, or island hopping to Pregnant Maiden Lake with eagle feeding.
romantic: Sunset dinner cruise around the islands.

plan: Kilim Geoforest mangroves by kayak, then duty-free shopping in Kuah.
romantic: Couples spa at the resort.

plan: Fly to Kuala Lumpur. Evening in Bukit Bintang and the Jalan Alor food street.
romantic: Rooftop bar facing the Petronas Towers.

plan: Batu Caves in the morning, then the Petronas Twin Towers skybridge and shopping at Pavilion and Suria KLCC.
romantic: Evening fountain show at KLCC Park.

plan: Sunway Lagoon theme and water park, then the New Year’s Eve celebrations.
romantic: New Year’s Eve fireworks at the Petronas Towers.

plan: Merdeka Square and Central Market, then a final shopping round at Mid Valley Megamall.
romantic: Farewell dinner with a skyline view.

plan: Fly from Manila to Busuanga (Coron) and transfer to the resort. Easy first evening.
romantic: Sunset drinks on the resort jetty.

plan: Coron Island tour: Kayangan Lake, Twin Lagoon and Barracuda Lake.
romantic: Night soak in the Maquinit saltwater hot springs.

plan: Snorkel the Japanese World War II shipwrecks and Siete Pecados reef, then climb Mount Tapyas for sunset.
romantic: Candlelit dinner at the resort.

plan: Morning fast ferry from Coron to El Nido (about three and a half hours; book early). Afternoon at Las Cabanas beach.
romantic: Sunset at Las Cabanas.

plan: Island Tour A: kayak the Big Lagoon, Small Lagoon and Secret Lagoon.
romantic: Dinner at a beach bar with lanterns in the sand.

plan: Island Tour C: Hidden Beach, Secret Beach and the Matinloc Shrine viewpoint.
romantic: Book a private boat so you have the beaches to yourselves.

plan: Nacpan Beach and the Las Cabanas zipline over the sea, then New Year’s Eve in El Nido.
romantic: New Year’s Eve dinner at your resort.

plan: Taraw Cliff via ferrata climb in the morning for the view, then a lazy beach afternoon.
romantic: Final sunset at Marimegmeg beach.

plan: Land in Malé and take the speedboat to Maafushi, a lively local island with lots of excursions.
romantic: Sunset on the tourist beach (dress modestly in the village; it is a local community).

plan: Snorkeling trip with turtles and a sandbank picnic.
romantic: Private picnic on the sandbank.

plan: Snorkel with nurse sharks and stingrays, or an introductory scuba dive.
romantic: Dolphin-watching cruise at sunset.

plan: Jet ski and parasailing in the morning; night fishing in the evening.
romantic: Stargazing on the beach.

plan: Resort day pass with lunch and reef snorkeling, or a second dive.
romantic: Sunset drinks at the resort bar.

plan: Speedboat to the resort and check into an overwater villa. House-reef snorkeling.
romantic: Private candlelit dinner on the beach.

plan: Kayaking and paddle-boarding over the lagoon, then the New Year’s Eve gala.
romantic: New Year’s Eve gala dinner at the resort.

plan: Spa morning and a final swim before flying home the next day.
romantic: Final sunset from your villa deck.
